answer.reason: The verses tell of her being taken by David, her plea for Solomon's kingship, and her pleading for Adonijah, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was taken by David and conceived a child by him
went in to the aged David and pleaded that Solomon should reign after him
clauses.quote: Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me

clauses.english: agreed to ask King Solomon to give Abishag to Adonijah
clauses.quote: Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

doubts: 1CH 3:5 gives the name Bathshua, daughter of Ammiel, which may be the same woman but is not certain, so it was left out.
PSA 51:1 is only a heading naming her and MAT 1:6 only a genealogy, so neither was used.
